stem:
The model shows Earth in four different positions in its orbit around the sun.

Which statement correctly explains which position of Earth represents summer in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: Position 1, because the Western Hemisphere is facing the sun

options.label: B
options.text: Position 2, because the Northern Hemisphere tilts toward the sun

options.label: C
options.text: Position 3, because Earth is at its closest point to the sun in its orbit

options.label: D
options.text: Position 4, because Earth is traveling at its fastest rate in its orbit

visual_elements: Diagram labeled Orbit of Earth Around the Sun showing four Earth positions numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 around a circle with the Sun in the middle, with arrows indicating the orbit direction.
